snippet.title: Iron Blight - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
BUY %20 OFF: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4001350/Iron_Blight/

Iron Blight is a survival horror game set in a cold, rainy Eastern Bloc town. You are trapped in a room as abominations claw at your door, with nowhere to run. You must survive the feverish night, uncover the horrors lurking in the shadows, and above all, find your wife, Valeria.

The world is dead. The state has collapsed. In a forgotten Eastern Bloc town, you are alone but not truly alone. Something stirs beyond the walls, and none of it means you well. You have only one reason to keep going: survive long enough to find your wife, Valeria. But in the cold and darkness of this unforgiving night, will you ever make it back to her?

#ironblight #rockpaperpublisher #ronesansinteractive #survivalhorrorgames
